narrative.intro: OptumServe Health Services received $1.9B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. OptumServe won 11 awards so far, with an average award size of $170M. Obligations fell 26.3% year over year. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the dominant buyer, obligating $1.8B to OptumServe in FY2026 to date. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the largest NAICS market for OptumServe, accounting for $1.8B in obligations. Smaller markets include Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists at $11M and All Other Outpatient Care Centers at $10.8M. Historical year-by-year obligations show a recent peak at $2.5B in FY25 and a prior high of $1.6B in FY24, with earlier totals of $711M in FY23, $874M in FY22, and $756M in FY21. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date. Use these figures to prioritize outreach to the VA and to align services with physician office contracting opportunities where the bulk of current obligations are concentrated.

sections.heading: How has OptumServe Health Services’ federal business changed year over year?
sections.body: OptumServe Health Services’ obligations fell 26.3% year over year. OptumServe obligated $1.9B in FY26 to date, down from $2.5B in FY25. OptumServe had earlier totals of $1.6B in FY24, $711M in FY23, $874M in FY22, and $756M in FY21.

sections.heading: Who are the main buyers and what markets drive OptumServe’s federal obligations?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the main buyer, obligating $1.8B in FY26 to date. OptumServe’s largest market is Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) at $1.8B, with smaller activity in Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists at $11M and All Other Outpatient Care Centers at $10.8M.

faq.q: How much does OptumServe Health Services make from federal contracts?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services received $1.9B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. OptumServe won 11 awards in FY2026 to date, with an average award size of $170M. Historical totals show $2.5B in FY25 and $1.6B in FY24.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from OptumServe Health Services?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs buys most from OptumServe Health Services, obligating $1.8B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Health and Human Services and the Department of Defense also bought from OptumServe, obligating $11.5M and $11M respectively.

faq.q: What does OptumServe Health Services sell to the government?
faq.a: OptumServe Health Services sells physician and outpatient health services to the government, led by Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) at $1.8B. OptumServe also sells services in Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists at $11M and All Other Outpatient Care Centers at $10.8M.

faq.q: Which OptumServe Health Services contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: The dataset does not list expiring-contract details by name or date, so specific expiring contracts are not provided. The available figures show current obligations and award counts but do not identify expiring contracts.
